usedBy.assignFailed: Couldn't change who uses the phone
usedBy.title: Used by
usedBy.singleChatHint: For a single chat, pick the phone with the Phone button in its message box.

panel.title: Phone
panel.controlHint: Click to tap, drag to swipe, type to enter text. Right click goes back.

developer.title: Turn on developer options
developer.body: Settings → About phone → tap Build number seven times.

debugging.title: Allow USB debugging
debugging.body: Settings → System → Developer options → USB debugging.

plugIn.title: Plug it in and tap Allow
plugIn.body: Tick “Always allow from this computer” so it stays allowed.

overview.adbTitle: Godmode needs adb to talk to phones
overview.adbCanInstall: adb is Android's free debugging bridge from Google. Godmode installs its own copy (about 16 MB) — nothing else on your computer changes.
overview.adbManual: Install Android's platform-tools (adb) and make sure it's on your PATH, or set its path below.
overview.waitingOk: A phone is waiting for your OK
overview.waitingConnect: A phone is waiting to connect
overview.emptyDescription: Plug an Android phone into this computer with a USB cable. It shows up here on its own.

chip.tooltipNone: Let this chat use your Android phones
chip.title: Android phones
chip.description: Runs in this chat see the screen, tap, type, open apps and run shell commands.

field.empty: No phones yet — connect one and this agent can use it.
field.hint: Every run of this agent can control these. A single chat can add more with the phone button in its message box.

wifi.title: Connect a phone over Wi-Fi
wifi.description: On the phone: Settings → Developer options → Wireless debugging. The phone and this computer must be on the same network.
wifi.pairHint: Tap “Pair device with pairing code” on the phone and enter what it shows.
wifi.addressHint: The one at the top of the Wireless debugging screen (not the pairing port).

edit.title: Edit phone
edit.description: Agents see the name and the description when they work with this phone.
edit.placeholder: Test phone, signed in to the shop's TikTok account. Don't change system settings.

forget.title: Forget “{{name}}”?
forget.body: Godmode forgets the phone's name and description.
forget.oneUserFallback: The agent or chat using it loses it.
forget.manyUsers: The {{n}} agents and chats using it lose it.
forget.rest: When you plug it in again it shows up as a new phone. Nothing on the phone changes.

device.typeAria: Text to type on the phone
device.asciiOnly: adb types plain ASCII only. Use the phone's keyboard for ä, é or emoji.
device.unknownDescription: It may have been forgotten. Plug it in again and it shows up as a new phone.
device.hint: Click to tap · drag to swipe · hold to long-press · scroll to swipe · right click or <kbd>Esc</kbd> for back · type to enter text

screen.ariaInteractive: Screen of {{name}}. Click to tap, drag to swipe, type to enter text.
screen.unlock: Unlock the phone and tap Allow
